verses.1: A song of ascents by David. O LORD, my heart has not grown lofty, nor have my eyes looked up haughtily, nor have I walked in great or wondrous things beyond myself.
verses.2: If I had not calmed my soul, like a weaned child on its mother—like a weaned child, my soul lies on me.
verses.3: Let Israel hope in the LORD from now and forever.

notes:
Notes
- v. 2: The metaphor of the weaned child is rendered as "like a weaned child on its mother" to maintain clarity and poetic resonance. The phrase "lies on me" reflects the Hebrew's reflexive construction and the sense of inner stillness.
raw:
[1] A song of ascents by David. O LORD, my heart has not grown lofty, nor have my eyes looked up haughtily, nor have I walked in great or wondrous things beyond myself.

[2] If I had not calmed my soul, like a weaned child on its mother—like a weaned child, my soul lies on me.

[3] Let Israel hope in the LORD from now and forever.
